name: PathWeaver
description: Search for paths, verify them in-game, and export GDR or GDR2 macros.

issues.info: Report problems on the GitHub issue tracker.

general-title.name: General
general-title.description: Ordinary play needs no setup. Open Pause > PathWeaver for Solve, Replay and Export. Search starts with the established defaults.

solve-tps.name: Solve tick rate
solve-tps.description: Physics ticks per second for the next Solve. 480 uses the experimental in-game search with Eclipse 1.9.4. Replay uses the rate stored in its plan.

path-quality.name: Simpler ship/wave paths
path-quality.description: Try roomier corridors and fewer extra clicks for ship and wave, without a CPS limit. Experimental; may take longer or choose a different path. Off keeps the established search.

debug-information.name: Detailed diagnostics
debug-information.description: Show extra search details, the path preview, hitboxes and diagnostic logs. Leave off for a clean screen. Does not improve Solve.

playback-title.name: Replay controls
playback-title.description: Optional shortcuts. The mouse and pause menu are enough for normal use. FPS and macro timing are not changed by playback speed.

key-pause.name: Pause / resume Replay
key-pause.description: Pause Replay or the path preview during Solve. This does not save or stop the search. Use Pause > PathWeaver > Save and stop to keep a search for later.

key-step1.name: Advance 1 tick
key-step1.description: While Replay or its preview is paused, advance by one physics tick. Hold the key to repeat.

key-step10.name: Advance 10 ticks
key-step10.description: While Replay or its preview is paused, advance by ten physics ticks. Hold the key to repeat.

key-replay.name: Restart Replay
key-replay.description: Replay the saved path from the beginning. This does not start a new Solve.

key-quit.name: Leave level
key-quit.description: Return to the level screen. To keep an unfinished search, use Save and stop in the PathWeaver pause menu first.

key-faster.name: Faster Replay
key-faster.description: Increase Replay or preview speed. This changes viewing speed, not the macro timing or Solve physics.

key-slower.name: Slower Replay
key-slower.description: Decrease Replay or preview speed. This changes viewing speed, not the macro timing or Solve physics.

key-seek-back.name: Seek Replay backward
key-seek-back.description: Move backward through Replay or its preview. While paused, step back instead. Hold to move farther.

key-seek-forward.name: Seek Replay forward
key-seek-forward.description: Move forward through Replay or its preview. While paused, step forward instead. Hold to move farther.

diagnostic-title.name: Diagnostic controls
diagnostic-title.description: Extra tools for investigating a problem. Enable Detailed diagnostics to configure these shortcuts.

key-overlay.name: Show / hide details
key-overlay.description: Show or hide the detailed overlay. Available with Detailed diagnostics. The PathWeaver bot badge stays visible.

key-render.name: Show / hide level during Solve
key-render.description: Diagnostic control. Toggle level drawing while Solve runs. Search keeps running when the level is hidden.

key-hitboxes.name: Show collision shapes
key-hitboxes.description: Cycle between normal view, collision shapes, and shapes only. Requires Detailed diagnostics and an automated session.

key-itermap.name: Show search history
key-itermap.description: Diagnostic control. Show where attempts failed and repairs were made. Requires Detailed diagnostics.

key-replaypanel.name: Show path preview
key-replaypanel.description: Diagnostic control. Show or hide the in-game record of the best tested attempt. Requires Detailed diagnostics.

key-takeover-end.name: End manual test input
key-takeover-end.description: Developer control. End a manual input test started through a diagnostic configuration. Not needed for ordinary Solve or Replay.
